property_summary: For every call to transfer, the reference contract always reverts (call fails) when the _tos array is empty; the mutant allowing _tos.length >= 0 lets the call succeed for empty arrays, breaking this invariant.
change_summary: Change the require check from _tos.length > 0 to _tos.length >= 0 (always true) so transfer proceeds even when _tos is empty, affecting revert behavior for empty arrays.
